steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: De-industrialisation is the decline in the importance of the secondary sector (manufacturing) in a country's economy, measured by output or employment. | Definition: A post-industrial economy is one where the service sector (tertiary) and knowledge-based industries (quaternary) dominate, having replaced manufacturing as the main source of employment and GDP. | Key Concept: Science parks are located near universities and focus on research and high-tech industries. Business parks are developments offering modern office space for service-sector companies.
